<subject>Draft of Network Transition Team Memo to David Larsen</subject>
<body>
David, As we just discussed, this is the transition memo suggesting that you place a call to Stephen Mclaughlin. As noted in the memo, we are still working through with the legal department what leave status our engineers would be required to take while serving on the private network expansion and the publicly funded fiber rollout. The answer to this question may determine their willingness to serve, in some cases.
</body>
